questiontext.text:
Prototype for Go WAT questions. The learner submits a complete Go source file containing package main, any imports, and their functions, but no main function. Each test case's testcode is Go statements compiled into a generated harness main, selected by argument, one execution per test. Test code may use fmt and the learner's identifiers only.

Template parameters (JSON), all optional and space-separated: banned tokens that must not appear, required tokens that must appear, limit countable bounds (return=N, bodylines=N). Tokens are keywords or identifiers (word-boundary match on comment- and literal-stripped source), selectors like errors.Is, operators from the fixed table (== != + & && || ! <- := % *), the pseudo-token nakedreturn, or literals (digit sequences, a quote character, or a % verb such as %w) matched on comment-stripped source. A test case whose testcode is exactly // rules prints rules ok when every check passes. On a violation the wrapper prints the reason as the first test's output and skips compilation.
